authority.scope: Claude Pro and Google AI Pro money-page editorial plus first-party provider-reference facts only
authority.rule: Never override AI Premium Shop catalog eligibility, local price, access model, payment, delivery, refund or warranty, review, provider authorization or other protected commercial truth. Local BDT values must come from the governed public projection at build/runtime.

local_payment.rule: These are AI Premium Shop public payment references, not claims about payment methods accepted directly by Anthropic or Google.

pro.positioning: Claude Pro is Anthropic's paid individual plan. Anthropic says it provides at least five times the usage per session compared with Free, plus priority access during high-traffic periods, early access to new features, Claude Code and Cowork. API usage is billed separately.

max.positioning: Anthropic positions Max as higher-usage individual access above Pro, with 5x or 20x Pro usage capacity depending on the selected Max tier.

team.official_reference: Standard: $25/member monthly or $20/member/month billed annually; Premium: $125/member monthly or $100/member/month billed annually
team.positioning: Anthropic Team is for 2 to 150 members and supports Standard and Premium seats. A local catalog label must not be assumed to represent an Anthropic Team seat or workspace unless the exact arrangement is confirmed.

availability.statement: Anthropic lists Bangladesh among locations where Claude can be accessed.

account_policy.statement: Anthropic Consumer Terms say users may not share account login information, API keys or account credentials with anyone else, may not make the account available to anyone else, and may not resell the Services.

pro.official_reference: $19.99/month on the current Google One plan page
pro.positioning: Google AI Pro is a Google One AI plan with 5 TB storage and expanded access to Gemini and other Google AI features. Exact models, feature availability and usage limits remain provider-controlled and can change.

availability.statement: Google lists Bangladesh among countries where Google AI Pro and Google AI Ultra are available.

limits.statement: Google says Gemini Apps usage limits are compute-based and depend on factors such as prompt complexity, models, features and chat length.

family.statement: Google documents family sharing for Google One and says family members on a Google AI Pro membership can enjoy select AI benefits. Some benefits and limits vary, so a local AI Premium Shop Shared listing must not be assumed to be Google family sharing or provider-authorized resale.
